data.narrative:
Precision Neuroscience is a Series C-stage biotech company that has raised $180M to date. The valuation framework draws on a peer set of 3 same-sector, same-stage private companies (Colossal Biosciences, Chai Discovery, New Limit) and 3 public Biotech & Health comparables (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L).

Two methods triangulate on a defensible range. Stage-progression applies a 1.7x step-up multiplier to the $180M total raised proxy, yielding $306M. Peer-median anchors to the 3 identified private comps, which span $3.1B to $10.3B with a median of $3.8B. Public-comp anchoring via P/S multiple (9.2x median across the 3 public tickers) cannot be applied due to absence of target revenue disclosure, typical for private firms. 

The two applicable methods produce a wide range reflecting heterogeneity in peer-stage valuations. The triangulated analysis supports $260M (low), $2.1B (median), and $4.4B (high). The disparity between stage-progression ($306M) and peer-median ($3.8B) reflects material uncertainty around whether Precision Neuroscience's technology risk, commercial traction, and capital efficiency track closer to early-stage norms or to better-capitalized peers. Without disclosed revenue or clinical milestone data, downside anchors near $260M while upside exposure to the peer median extends toward $4.4B.
